## What and why

Closes #

## Verification

Commands, outcomes, screenshots for UI changes, and any remaining gates.

Link the Actions run for the current commit. State whether evidence uses fixtures
or real public media. Do not count self-review as independent review.

## Risks and follow-up

Operational impact, compatibility changes, known coverage gaps and scoped follow-up issues.

## Review

- [ ] Scoped to one problem; no unrelated dependency or change
- [ ] Meaningful behavior/failure tests
- [ ] Cancellation and resource limits considered
- [ ] Access policy and security boundary preserved
- [ ] Keyboard/mobile/reduced motion checked if UI changed
- [ ] Docs and ADRs updated where needed
- [ ] No secrets, private URLs or downloaded media
- [ ] Branch is current with main; required checks passed; review conversations resolved
